steps: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear and soak it twenty minutes.
Fry the onion in ghee to a deep gold, fifteen minutes, and set a third aside.
Add the garlic, ginger, bizar and turmeric and warm them a minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomatoes and the pierced limes, pour in water at one and a half times the volume of the rice, and season.
Bring it up, add the rice, cover and cook fifteen minutes on a low heat.
Lay the prawns over the rice, cover and give it five more minutes; they cook in the steam.
Rest it ten minutes and scatter with the reserved onion, coriander and chilli.
